crossRefs.note: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean…
Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,
Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection…

translations.web: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
translations.bsb: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
translations.kjv: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
translations.asv: Already ye are clean because of the word which I have spoken unto you.
